#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
#
# Destination is not hardcoded here (it isn't decided in this repo yet); it must
# be provided via the BACKUP_DEST environment variable when this script is run
# (e.g. from cron/register-job.sh):
#   - local path/mount:   BACKUP_DEST=/mnt/backups
#   - remote host:path:   BACKUP_DEST=user@host:/path/to/backups
set -eu

DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-}"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: no backup destination configured. Set BACKUP_DEST (local path or user@host:/path) before running backup.sh." >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # Remote destination (user@host:/path). Prefer rsync if available,
        # fall back to scp.
        if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            rsync -a "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        else
            scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        fi
        ;;
    *)
        # Local path or mount point.
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
